theorems.name: Submission.ted_lpm_abstract_monotonicity
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ), 1 ≤ n → ∀ p : ℝ, (n : ℝ) < p → ∀ (μ : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (H : Amb n ℓ → Amb n ℓ) (y : Amb n ℓ) (R S Λ : ℝ), 0 < R → R < S → 0 < Λ → μ (closedBall y S) < ⊤ → IntegrableOn H (closedBall y S) μ → ∫⁻ x in closedBall y S, ‖H x‖ₑ ^ p ∂μ < ⊤ → (ENNReal.ofReal (R ^ (p - n)) * ∫⁻ x in closedBall y R, ‖H x‖ₑ ^ p ∂μ) ^ (1 / p) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((p - n) / (4 * p) * Λ) → (∀ (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (T ρ : ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → Antitone φ → (∀ t : ℝ, t ≤ 1 → φ t = 1) → (∀ t : ℝ, T ≤ t → φ t = 0) → 0 < ρ → T * ρ < S → ∫ x, ((n : ℝ) * φ (‖x - y‖ / ρ) + ‖x - y‖ / ρ * deriv φ (‖x - y‖ / ρ)) ∂μ ≤ -∫ x, φ (‖x - y‖ / ρ) * inner ℝ (x - y) (H x) ∂μ) → ∃ F : ℝ → ℝ, (∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r ≤ R → Real.exp (-Λ) ≤ F r ∧ F r ≤ Real.exp Λ ∧ |F r - 1| ≤ Real.exp (Λ / 2) / 2 * Λ * (r / R) ^ (1 - (n : ℝ) / p) ∧ (Λ ≤ 1 → |F r - 1| ≤ Λ * (r / R) ^ (1 - (n : ℝ) / p))) ∧ ∀ s r : ℝ, 0 < s → s ≤ r → r ≤ R → F s * ((μ (closedBall y s)).toReal / s ^ n) + (F s - 1) ≤ F r * ((μ (closedBall y r)).toReal / r ^ n) + (F r - 1)
